checks.name: configuration-free Sheets discovery and generated method effects
every account action requires an explicit profile
native live reads preview their IDs and exact ranges
updates, row insertion and clear preview as writes
invalid ranges, overflow, unsafe numbers and nested cells are refused
offline, read-only and unknown arguments stop execution
raw writes need explicit acknowledgment and generated bodies retain validation

limits: Synthetic CLI previews/refusals only; no live Google or cell readback
